scope: FAM-003 resident access, tray menu, Global Settings, Quick Access, and PR2 same-PR Codex Connector review-churn coverage
purpose: Prevent the FAM-003 PR2 loop from treating each Codex Connector finding as an isolated bug by proving source-truth, implementation, validator, fixture, and sibling-variant coverage before requesting another PR review.

families.title: FAM-003 settings focus routing and route-only tray context coverage
representative_comment_patterns: Tray Help focus value silently normalizes to Quick Access
AI Status, Privacy, or Owner route fallback opens Quick Access instead of the intended tray context

generated_mutation_coverage: focus="tray_visibility" must be rejected or routed to supported Tray parent context
focus="ai_status" must keep Tray parent selected with AI doorway context
focus="privacy" must keep Tray parent selected with privacy doorway context
focus="owner_routes" must keep Tray parent selected with future-gated owner route context
unknown focus values may fall back only to Quick Access without masquerading as a supported route
sibling_variant_replay: Tray parent and Quick Access child page selection state

families.title: FAM-003 native Windows tray submenu handle and dispatch coverage
representative_comment_patterns: CreatePopupMenu and AppendMenuW use default 32-bit ctypes signatures on 64-bit Windows

generated_mutation_coverage: AppendMenuW must accept HMENU / UINT / UINT_PTR / LPCWSTR
TrackPopupMenu, DestroyMenu, PostMessageW, and SetForegroundWindow signatures remain explicit
MF_POPUP submenu IDs are pointer-sized UINT_PTR values
Submenu command dispatch keeps parent and child command IDs distinct
